problem_statement: Add a module named `core_mutex_priority_inheritance` that, when enabled, makes mutexes mitigate priority inversion. In a scenario where a low-priority thread holds a mutex, a higher-priority thread blocks while trying to lock it, and a medium-priority thread does not need that mutex, the medium-priority thread must not run until the low-priority holder has released the mutex and the higher-priority thread has acquired it. As a result, the high-priority thread must not be delayed by unrelated medium-priority work.
